model.temperature_policy: Omitted in thinking mode; provider default, matching legacy protocol
model.context_window_note: Pi declaration, not a verified provider capacity or token measurement
model.model_alias_version_policy: Record provider response/version metadata when available; do not claim fixed weights

runtime.environment_gate: Resolve Pi/cache/broker paths within this independent repository and pass isolation fixtures before online execution
runtime.credentials: Use existing local credential entry or environment variable, never persist secret values in logs

data.code_pair_selection: First and last target in the existing preregistered pilot target order; selection uses metadata only, never scores
data.online_initial_memory: empty separately for every method and benchmark
data.long_history_checks: Frozen legacy snapshots and model-free fixtures, no added online long stream
data.scoring_mask: Reuse records/scorer-issues.json; masks do not change legal execution or memory permissions

memory.serialization: Legacy json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False), complete entries only; byte budget is not a token budget
memory.no_memory: New task context; no cross-task injection or writing
memory.bounded_icl: Full own observable episodes in original order; drop oldest complete episode until within byte cap; no summary
memory.episodic_retrieval: Lowercase word-set Jaccard over prompt and episode.text; top-3, ties favor newer episode; chronological injection, oldest-complete-episode byte eviction
memory.write_source: Own legal task prompt and visible assistant actions/text/tool results; excludes hidden scoring and reasoning

mem0.mode: open-source base vector memory, graph disabled

awm_online.mode: online own-trajectory workflows, no gold success labels

ace_online.mode: online Generator/Reflector/Curator and incremental playbook, no hidden GT

memory.complex_pending_policy: Unfilled values block corresponding online calls; confirm exact configuration before each complex method

budgets.monetary_hard_limit_status: Propose carrying forward prior no-hard-cap setting, subject to this confirmation
budgets.accounting: All roles, retries and failed calls retained; unavailable usage or unverified price remains unknown rather than zero

recording: sanitized actual payload and memory-block mapping
role-specific usage and complete generation duration
submission audit and separately stored hidden scoring
stop_conditions: unknown usage silently recorded as zero
